prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.3 °C (65% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.3 °C (56% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.8 °C (49% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.97 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.58 s (3% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.58 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (5% below healthy). No internal bypassing detected; volumetric efficiency is optimal.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.8 bar (within 2% of healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.1 °C (68% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.7 °C (58% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.2 °C (50% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.90 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.57 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.8 bar (within 2% of healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
